$note: Extracted 6 Aug 2026. Fully mobile/private tented camp (up to 6 ensuite tents), priced per-night for the whole group rather than per person sharing - distinct pricing shape from its sister Sarara properties.
region: Samburu Ecosystem (Namunyak area, near Buffalo Springs & Kalama airstrips)

rates.unit: per night, minimum 1 night for 4 guests

capacity: Up to 6 ensuite tents (solar-heated bucket showers), wellness/media tent, dining/lounge tent, mobile pool

childPolicy.note: All ages welcome but more suitable for 5 years and older.

inclusions: Full board, soft drinks/local beers/non-premium wines/spirits, Buffalo Springs & Kalama airstrip transfers, transfers between Sarara properties, statutory taxes, laundry, game drives, fireside stories, private Samburu guide/spotter, cultural immersions, bush meals, stargazing, sundowners.
exclusions: Community Heritage fee, champagne/premium spirits, beading/blacksmithing, massage ($40-100), Samburu dancers, helicopter excursions.
notes: Exclusive-use minimum charge for 4 adults. Optional desert-camp extension (Lake Turkana/Chalbi Desert) priced on request.
